hypotheses.title: Single-Line Variance Risk Premium Conditioned on Cashflow Quality (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pure single-line nested implementation of cross-sectional variance risk premium conditioned by fundamental corporate quality. Eliminates multi-line parser ambiguity on WorldQuant BRAIN, isolating high cashflow compounders experiencing volatility mispricing.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during prolonged market-wide volatility expansions where realized volatility exceeds implied volatility across all market tiers.

hypotheses.title: Single-Line Volatility Term Structure Backwardation Reversion (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pure single-line implementation of term structure slope inversion. Buys high cashflow compounders whose short-term 30-day IV has temporarily spiked above 90-day IV in acute panic.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when inverted term structures correctly anticipate persistent corporate deterioration.

hypotheses.title: Single-Line Downside Put Skew Exhaustion Conditioned on Quality (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pure single-line implementation fading acute put-minus-call skew surges on firms with superior operational cash generation, capturing liquidity mean-reversion as panic hedging subsides.
confounders: Severe overnight market-wide black swan events
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic solvency shocks where elevated put demand precedes further collapse.
